rawContent: @WeAre__Warriors Every time friends come to me with stories about new partners' allegedly "crazy" exes, I ask if they'd let me contact the exes to check-in and compare notes. Since #MeToo, more and more friends have given me the go-ahead to contact the exes. This is a powerful change!

I want every journalist I know to read and reflect on this piece by @alienmelon, whether or not they report on #metoo. The way journalists engage with survivors is often retraumatizing. We need more trauma-informed reporting. (Content note for harms)
https://t.co/sIE9VWtf2S

I wrote Disrupting The Bystander: When #metoo Happens Among Friends because I know that friends are crucial both to recovering from harm and changing patterns of harm.
